extracted.intended_audience: investor relations professionals (IR teams at publicly traded companies), corporate communications and finance officers
extracted.subtask_description: Best-practice standards for preparing and issuing quarterly earnings press releases for publicly held companies, covering timing, required content, disclosure norms, and IR best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core Standard
rubrics_metrics.description: First issue a broadly disseminated news release containing the new material information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NIRI states the best practice, under any circumstances, is to first issue a broadly disseminated news release with the new material information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issue as soon as practicable after quarter-end
rubrics_metrics.description: Earnings press releases should generally be issued as soon as practicable after quarter-end.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan release timing around market hours
rubrics_metrics.description: Plan release timing around market hours (typically before market open or after market close).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose timing to minimize market disruption and maximize investor access; typical windows are before market open or after market close.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide minimum 4 hours between release and conference call
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide minimum 4 hours between release and conference call.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows investors and analysts time to review results before the call.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline summarizing financial highlights
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a headline that summarizes the financial highlights of the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary section with key metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a summary section with key metrics (revenue, EPS, guidance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use consistent, prominent presentation of the core financial metrics investors expect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparison to prior periods
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide comparisons to prior periods (year‑over‑year, sequential).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comparative context helps investors assess performance trends (yoy and sequential comparisons).

rubrics_metrics.name: Discussion and analysis from management
rubrics_metrics.description: Include management discussion and analysis of the results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain the drivers behind the numbers rather than only reporting figures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconciliation of GAAP to non‑GAAP measures (Reg G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide reconciliation of GAAP to non‑GAAP measures in accordance with Reg G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow Regulation G expectations by reconciling non‑GAAP measures back to GAAP and explaining adjustments.

rubrics_metrics.name: CEO/CFO quote with strategic context
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a CEO or CFO quote that provides strategic context for the results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quotes should connect the quarter's performance to broader strategy and outlook.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forward‑looking guidance (if provided)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include forward‑looking guidance when the company chooses to provide it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When giving guidance, ensure it is clearly labeled and consistent with prior disclosures and the safe harbor language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conference call details
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide conference call details for investors and analysts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include date, time, dial‑in/webcast information and any replay details; coordinate timing with the release (see timing guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Forward‑looking statements safe harbor
rubrics_metrics.description: Include forward‑looking statements safe harbor language when appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use standard safe harbor wording to qualify forward‑looking statements and mitigate legal risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: About the company (boilerplate)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include an 'About the company' boilerplate section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard company background text helps new readers understand the business context.

rubrics_metrics.name: IR contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide investor relations contact information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include name, phone, email and any other contact points so investors and media can follow up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain consistent format quarter‑to‑quarter
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain a consistent press release format from quarter to quarter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consistency aids comparability and investor comprehension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the same metrics each period (avoid cherry‑picking)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report the same set of metrics each period and avoid selectively presenting measures that make the company look better.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Changing which metrics are reported can mislead; any changes should be clearly disclosed and justified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclose changes in non‑GAAP definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose any changes in how non‑GAAP measures are defined.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If non‑GAAP definitions change, explain the change and its impact on comparability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide segment information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide segment information in the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Segment disclosures improve transparency about drivers of performance across business units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discuss business drivers, not just numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: Discuss underlying business drivers and context, not just report the numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Management should explain what caused results and how business dynamics are evolving.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adopt a written disclosure policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Adopt and follow a written disclosure policy for communications with investors and the market.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A formal policy clarifies responsibilities and processes for timely and consistent disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designate authorized spokespersons
rubrics_metrics.description: Designate authorized spokespersons to speak for the company.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limiting spokespeople reduces risk of inconsistent or unauthorized disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain quiet periods around earnings
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain quiet periods around earnings announcements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quiet periods help avoid selective disclosure and reduce regulatory/clerk risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address one‑time items transparently
rubrics_metrics.description: Address one‑time or unusual items transparently in the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly separate recurring performance from one‑time events and explain their effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide reconciliations and definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide reconciliations and definitions for non‑GAAP measures and other disclosures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure readers can reconcile and understand terms used; include definitions and reconciliation tables where appropriate.
